subject: Security architecture review — coordinating SOC 2 evidence deep-dive

Subject: Security architecture review — coordinating SOC 2 evidence deep-dive

Hi Maria,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, the next step is a focused architecture/deep-dive with our security and infra teams so we can line up the SOC 2 evidence, encryption approach, audit log retention, and SSO flow for Sentra's deployment.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- Quick intro & scope (5m)
- Architecture walk (15m)
- SOC 2 evidence mapping & evidence owners (10m)
- Action items and calendar for artifact handoff (5m)

Availability from our side this week (PDT):
- Mon 6/8: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Tue 6/9: 09:00–11:00

If none of those work, send a couple of slots and we’ll accommodate. I’ll loop in Karthik (sec eng) and Evelyn (customer success) once we confirm so they can pull the right artifacts.

I’m attaching a quick SOC2 evidence checklist to help prep — feel free to add to it.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com

Hi Priya,

Thanks — that agenda looks good. We’d like Jon Chang from our compliance vendor on the call as well (I’ve looped his team in separately). Preliminary availability (PDT):
- Mon 6/8: 11:00–12:00
- Tue 6/9: 09:30–10:30 or 16:00–17:00

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you share a high-level architecture diagram before the call? Even a single slide would help Jon orient.
2) We need to ensure the session covers audit log retention and how we can extract raw logs for our SIEM.

We’ll try to make 11:00 on Monday work, but I’ll confirm by EOD.

Best,

Head of IT Security | Sentra Health
maria.lopez@sentrahealth.com

I’ve attached a high-level architecture snapshot and a mapping workbook; both are redacted for external circulation. Karthik will cover KV cache/latency considerations and our encryption-at-rest/key-management options; he’ll also talk about how we expose audit logs (S3 export + push to webhooks).

Attachments: redwood-arch-highlevel-v1.png (single-slide), redwood-soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx

If Monday 6/8 at 11:00 PDT is workable for Jon, I’ll send a calendar invite for 45 minutes to give us some buffer. Otherwise we can do Tue 6/9 at 09:30.

Priya

On scope so you know what I’ll prepare:
